topic: owner's-manual preparation for sand, mud, heat and cold
statement: GasGas's 2021 owner's manual for the EC 250 / EC 300 gives condition-specific preparation for dry sand, wet sand, wet and muddy tracks, heat / slow technical riding, cold / snow: fit a steel rear sprocket in sand and mud; fit the air-filter dust/sand cover on dry sand; fit the air-filter rain cover in wet sand, mud and snow; check the air filter about every 30 minutes in difficult conditions; with regular use in sand change the piston every 10 operating hours; in heat or slow riding gear the bike down (lower secondary ratio) because frequent clutch use heats the oil.
